findings.label: Static date-header chevron
findings.description: Date section headers always show ▼ regardless of state. Dates are not collapsible; clicking the header does nothing. Fix: add date-level collapse state or remove ▼ from date headers and keep the toggle only on IP rows.

findings.label: IST date / UTC bulk-delete mismatch
findings.description: Logins in the first 5h30m of an IST day (before midnight UTC) are displayed under that IST date but fall outside the UTC window the bulk-delete endpoint sends to Supabase. Those rows survive a 'Del All' on their displayed date. Pre-existing tension between IST display and UTC storage; no code fix required but worth documenting.

findings.label: Excel filename uses UTC date
findings.description: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) gives the UTC date. After 18:30 IST the filename will show tomorrow's date. Fix: derive the filename date in IST.
